system.description:
This lesser wand holds a level 1 spell and carries 10 charges.

This wand holds a randomly determined spell. The Referee selects the spell when the wand is found; drag a spell onto this wand's sheet to embed it so casting consumes a charge.

Wands become useless with 0 charges. A wand can be recharged by casting a spell into it. There is a 5% chance per recharge that the wand will be destroyed.

A thin wand of pale, bone-white wood, polished smooth. Runes of no recognizable script wind about its length, and the tip ends in a plain rounded knob.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A slim, smoothly finished stick about 18" (45 cm) long, the wand fits comfortably in one hand. Its surface shows faint runes and hairline veins; one end tapers to a rounded tip while the other terminates in a small carved motif. It feels surprisingly light and balanced.
